mode: offline inventory only; no solver or model execution
disposition_basis: Zero eligible same-k, different-C body pairs with independent lineage in every audited dataset.
outcome_limitation: Historical evaluation outcomes already existed and were visible to this audit; it is not a blind inventory. Eligibility uses artifact validity, crash status, lineage, and the presence of an evaluation record, not score magnitudes. No C-S association is fitted or reported here.

datasets.notes: 16/20 bodies had k=0 and are ineligible for a concentration contrast. Four multi-failure bodies occupy k=25(C=0.2), k=10(C=0.5), k=5(C=1), k=5(C=1); no fixed-k group has two C levels. C is undefined at k=0.

datasets.generator: frozen 120-file single-shot pack; 40 unique bodies, exactly 3 replicas each (per v0.2 audit)
datasets.notes: All 90 audited eligible rows satisfy C=5/k exactly; each k has one C level. Confirmatory rows were persisted only as aggregates. The 120 files are 40 base bodies x 3 replicas, so they are not 120 independent units.

datasets.generator: Codex CLI 0.160.1, --model gpt-6-luna, one exact SSSP prompt per attempt; backend snapshot unavailable
datasets.notes: All completed bodies have k=0, so C is undefined and no k>=2 support exists.

datasets.generator: Google Gemini API, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite, one exact SSSP prompt per attempt; backend snapshot unavailable
datasets.notes: All completed bodies have k=0, so C is undefined and no k>=2 support exists.

datasets.crash_policy: Any crash in the diagnostic or evaluation suite makes a body ineligible under the frozen protocol; crashes are counted separately from diagnostic failures. Missing, malformed, or incomplete source-screen/diagnostic/evaluation evidence is invalid and cannot become an eligible body.
datasets.notes: All 13 bodies with k>=2 crash and are excluded. The 6 k=0 bodies are valid but cannot support a concentration contrast. 11 attempt directories lack complete validated evidence and are not eligible bodies. The nine k=2 bodies each crash on two diagnostic and two evaluation inputs; the singleton k=7 body has seven crashes each; the three k=30 bodies crash on all 30 diagnostic and evaluation inputs.

excluded_categories.reason: constructed controls, not independently generated natural solver bodies
synthetic mathematical simulation, not solver records
